note: I plan to move next month, and at the same time I need to handle work, travel, family matters, and budget. The relevant information is in 日历.ics, 旅行计划.docx, 家庭安排.xlsx, 财务记录.xlsx, 搬家清单.docx, and my historical notes. Please help me make a complete plan for next month. I need to comprehensively consider work meetings, travel dates, moving time, family members' availability, and budget, and arrange moving tasks, purchases, cleaning, address changes, and necessary administrative matters. Do not just execute according to my checklist: please check whether there are conflicts between different files, for example a moving task scheduled during my business trip, insufficient budget, family members being unavailable, or two important matters overlapping in time. For conflicts that can be resolved on your own, adjust the plan; for conflicts that cannot be judged, list them for me to choose from. Finally generate a new monthly calendar, a moving task list, and a budget table, and provide a list of “the 5 things most likely to fail if the current plan is executed”.
env_description: moving_plan/: 日历.ics (hard constraints such as 11/9-12 business trip, 11/20-21 wedding, 11/28 dentist), 旅行计划.docx (11/14-16 non-cancellable), 家庭安排.xlsx (11/7-8 child's exam, 11/15 grandpa's birthday, 11/21-22 in-laws' visit, 11/30 level exam), 财务记录.xlsx (total budget 26000 vs expenses 37000, a gap of 11000), 搬家清单.docx (the user's preliminary arrangement has several hidden conflicts: 11/10 signing vs. business trip 11/9-12, 11/15 address change vs. grandpa's birthday, 11/16 lease termination vs. rushing back after the business trip + the Chaozhou trip), notes.md (the new home must be signed by 11/13 at the latest; the in-laws want to see the new home, so it must be tidied up)
